name: Aggretsuko: The Daily Despair of Retsuko
source:
Retsuko has just been accepted into a company, she's proud and happy, but she has no idea what's coming.. Navigate through the daily life of the aggressive, socially awkward, accountant named Retsuko as she deals with her annoying co-workers and bosses by drinking alcohol and singing death metal, and maybe finding love...?


[From [url=https://cloudnovel.net/Numi/novel/aggretsuko-the-daily-despair-of-retsuko-wip]Cloudnovel[/url]]

Aggressive Retsuko Fan Game.
translation:
烈子刚刚被一家公司录取，她感到自豪和高兴，但她不知道接下来会发生什么。体验这位名叫烈子的好斗、社交尴尬的会计师的日常生活，她通过喝酒和唱死亡金属来对付烦人的同事和老板，也许还能找到爱情……？


[摘自[url=https://cloudnovel.net/Numi/novel/aggretsuko-the-daily-despair-of-retsuko-wip]Cloudnovel[/url]]

激进的烈子粉丝游戏。
